description:
The census that fz-afu.1 added matches a re-run to its wake by reading
`work_graph.applied` only. Wakes arrive on three events, all carrying an
AppliedStep:

- `work_graph.applied` (metadata.completion): a job completion
- `work_graph.dependencies_moved` (metadata.step): a nested product settles
  (drive.rs apply_product_changes / publish_dependency_movements)
- `work_graph.quiesced` (metadata.step): a drain step (flush_quiescence)

On `def main(), do: 1` the wake that re-runs ScopeCode(17) when the nested
def/1 compile settles is on `dependencies_moved`, so the merged census reports
it as "unattributed", and the merged docs/commit explain the gap as telemetry
design. It is not: counting all three events, matched wakes equal the tally's
changed_revision_wake exactly (18 = 18 here, 518 = 518 on Enum.take).

Change:
- The census reads wakes from all three events; "completed by" is the
  completion kind for `applied`, the event name for the other two.
- The "unattributed" row goes. The distiller cross-checks
  matched enqueued wakes == summed work_starts_changed_revision_wake and
  ignition + activation_frontier + blocked_waiter_expansion == distinct
  subjects, and exits nonzero printing both numbers when either fails.
- The checked-in fixture becomes `def main(), do: 1`: 44 starts, 26 subjects
  (13 kinds x {main/0, def/1 macro root}), 18 re-runs, all attributed (11 main
  side, 7 def/1 side).
- `.agent/strategies/profile-a-compilation.md` describes the three events and
  the loud cross-check.

Test: the distiller test fails against the merged distiller (missing the
dependencies_moved row) and passes after.
title: The census reads wakes from every step event and fails loudly on a mismatch
